subtitle: In the court of Amoghavarsha, a Jain scholar gathers scattered rules into a clear river of number and measure.

panels.shot: epic low-angle mid-shot in lamplit library hall
panels.action: Mahaviracharya sits cross-legged amid palm-leaf manuscripts and measuring rods, head slightly bowed in concentration, a faint light falling on his face as shadowy pillars of the Rashtrakuta capital rise behind him.

dialogue.text: In Rashtrakuta Manyakheta of the ninth century, Mahaviracharya the Jain scholar counts the world with verses of pure mathematics.

i18n.hi: नवम शताब्दी के राष्ट्रकूट मण्यखेट में, जैन आचार्य महावीराचार्य शुद्ध गणित की पद्यावली से जग को गिनते हैं।

panels.shot: wide establishing shot of Manyakheta from above
panels.action: A bird’s-eye view of bustling Manyakheta shows markets, temple spires, and the fortified palace of Amoghavarsha, with distant hills and river plains under a hazy Deccan sky.

dialogue.text: Under Rashtrakuta king Amoghavarsha I, Manyakheta hums with traders, builders and monks, all needing numbers to weigh, measure and plan.

i18n.hi: राष्ट्रकूट राजा अमोघवर्ष प्रथम के अधीन, मण्यखेट व्यापारी, निर्माता और भिक्षुओं से गूंजता है — सबको तौलने, नापने, योजना के लिए संख्या चाहिए।

panels.shot: intimate interior wide of merchants and architects at work
panels.action: In a colonnaded marketplace, merchants count heaps of grain with tally sticks as an architect studies a ground plan and a surveyor stretches a rope measure between two posts.

dialogue.text: Indian mathematics has grown through Aryabhata and Brahmagupta, yet traders still juggle scattered rules for fractions, shadows and volumes from many older treatises.

i18n.hi: आर्यभट, ब्रह्मगुप्त से भारतीय गणित बढ़ चुकी, पर व्यापारी अभी भी पुरानी ग्रंथों की भिन्न, छाया, घनफलों की बिखरी नियमों से जूझते हैं।

panels.shot: medium shot of Mahaviracharya in a Jain monastery study cell
panels.action: Mahaviracharya, robed simply as a Jain scholar, sits in a quiet cell lined with palm-leaf bundles, carefully turning a manuscript while a small oil lamp flickers beside inkpots and stylus.

dialogue.text: Mahaviracharya studies these works, honoring his Jain discipline, and begins to see that their scattered insights could be gathered into one ordered stream.

i18n.hi: महावीराचार्य इन ग्रंथों को साधना से पढ़ते हैं, जैन अनुशासन निभाते हुए देखते हैं कि बिखरी सूझ एक सुव्यवस्थित धारा में जुट सकती है।

panels.shot: over-the-shoulder close shot on palm leaf showing numerals and verse
panels.action: From behind his shoulder we see a palm leaf inscribed in neat Nagari script with mathematical verse and place-value numerals arranged in careful alignment beside a diagram of intersecting lines.

dialogue.text: Instead of composing astronomy, he chooses ganita alone, treating computation as an independent discipline worthy of its own systematic scripture.

i18n.hi: ज्योतिष रचने के बजाय वे केवल गणित चुनते हैं, गणना को स्वतंत्र विधा मानते हैं, अपनी व्यवस्थित शास्त्र की अधिकारी।

panels.shot: slow push-in close-up on Mahaviracharya’s thoughtful face
panels.action: Mahaviracharya pauses, stylus poised above the leaf, his eyes steady and reflective, the lamplight catching fine lines of age and concentration on his brow.

dialogue.speaker: mahaviracharya
dialogue.text: Let each rule stand in its proper place, so any mind may find it.

i18n.hi: हर नियम अपने सही स्थान पर हो, ताकि हर मन उसे आसानी से ढूंढ सके।

panels.shot: wide table shot showing organized sections of palm leaves
panels.action: On a low wooden table, separate stacks of labeled palm leaves are arranged in rows, some marked with diagrams of fractions, others with geometric shapes, shadow sticks, and combinatorial grids.

dialogue.text: He divides his work into clear chapters: arithmetic, fractions, measurement of figures, shadows, progressions, and combinations, each with verses and worked examples.

i18n.hi: वे ग्रंथ को साफ अध्यायों में बाँटते हैं — अंकगणित, भिन्न, आकृतियों का मापन, छायाएँ, प्रगति और संयोग — हर एक के पद्य और हल उदाहरणों सहित।

panels.shot: medium shot of Mahaviracharya teaching a young merchant in courtyard
panels.action: In a sunlit courtyard, Mahaviracharya explains from an open manuscript to a young merchant holding a counting board, while baskets of spices and metal weights lie nearby.

dialogue.text: His problems speak of real tasks: sharing goods, reckoning interest, sizing granaries, shaping tanks, and tracing the shadow of a gnomon to find heights.

i18n.hi: उनकी समस्याएँ असली कामों की बात करती हैं — माल बाँटना, ब्याज गिनना, कोठार नापना, तालाब गढ़ना, और शिखा की छाया से ऊँचाई निकालना।

panels.shot: diagrammatic-style scene of shadow measurement outdoors
panels.action: On open ground, a vertical staff casts a long shadow; nearby a student marks lengths with a cord while Mahaviracharya gestures calmly, mountains faint on the horizon.

dialogue.text: For shadows, he arranges rules of proportion at different sun heights, building on older siddhantas but setting them out with practical clarity.

i18n.hi: छायाओं के लिए वे अलग-अलग सूर्य ऊँचाई पर अनुपात के नियम जमाते हैं, पुराने सिद्धांतों पर चलते हुए भी उन्हें कामचलाऊ साफ अंदाज़ में रखते हैं।

panels.shot: close shot on palm leaf showing combinatorial arrangement
panels.action: A palm leaf lies flat bearing a verse and beneath it a grid of circles and lines showing combinations of chosen items, stylus resting beside it.

dialogue.text: In his chapter on combinations, he gathers existing ideas on choosing and arranging objects, shaping them into patterns that later generations will recognize as combinatorial reasoning.

i18n.hi: संयोग के अध्याय में वे वस्तुओं को चुनने-लगाने के पुराने विचारों को समेटते हैं, इन्हें ऐसे रूप देते हैं कि आगे की पीढ़ियाँ इन्हें संयोजन-चिन्तन के रूप में पहचानेंगी।

panels.shot: interior long shot in palace audience hall
panels.action: Within a grand audience hall, Amoghavarsha sits on a raised seat, courtiers lined along carved pillars, as Mahaviracharya approaches with a neatly bound stack of palm leaves held respectfully.

dialogue.text: When his compendium is ready, he dedicates the Ganita Sara Sangraha to his patron Amoghavarsha I, offering ordered knowledge to the king who shelters scholars and poets.

i18n.hi: जब संहिता तैयार होती है, वे गणित सार संग्रह अपने आश्रयदाता अमोघवर्ष प्रथम को समर्पित करते हैं — व्यवस्थित ज्ञान उस राजा को जो कवि और विद्वान की रक्षा करता है।

panels.shot: medium two-shot of Mahaviracharya and Amoghavarsha
panels.action: Amoghavarsha leans forward, examining the manuscript with interest, while Mahaviracharya bows slightly, serene and composed in his scholar’s robes.

dialogue.speaker: mahaviracharya
dialogue.text: May this collection guide merchants, builders and thinkers in your realm.

i18n.hi: यह संग्रह आपके राज्य के व्यापारी, निर्माता और चिन्तकों को राह दिखाए।

panels.shot: montage wide of different professions using mathematical rules
panels.action: A composite scene shows a merchant dividing accounts, a builder sketching a temple base, a land measurer pacing a field, each with a palm manuscript open nearby.

dialogue.text: Through its verses, rules that once lay scattered in many texts now flow together, ready for those who weigh gold, trace plans, or teach disciples in quiet cloisters.

i18n.hi: इन श्लोकों के सहारे, जो नियम पहले अनेक ग्रंथों में बिखरे थे, अब एक साथ बहते हैं — सोने तौलने वाले, नक्शा खींचने वाले, या शांत विहारों में शिष्यों को पढ़ाने वाले सबके लिए तैयार।

panels.shot: time-lapse style wide shot of manuscripts being copied over years
panels.action: Several scribes sit in line, across eras suggested by subtle costume changes, copying the Ganita Sara Sangraha onto fresh leaves, stacked bundles accumulating around them.

dialogue.text: Centuries pass; copyists preserve his thousand-verse compendium, so that later mathematicians can compare, question and extend the rules he gathered.

i18n.hi: सदियाँ बीतती हैं; नकलनवीस उनके हज़ार श्लोकों के संग्रह को बचाए रखते हैं, ताकि आगे के गणितज्ञ उनके नियमों की तुलना, परीक्षा और विस्तार कर सकें।

panels.shot: modern-era scholar study shot as epilogue
panels.action: In a modern archive room, a historian gently turns pages of a printed edition of Ganita Sara Sangraha, surrounded by shelves of books on Indian mathematics.

dialogue.text: Today historians read Mahaviracharya’s work to see a moment when Indian mathematics stands on its own feet, shaped for practical use yet conscious of its lineage.

i18n.hi: आज इतिहासकार महावीराचार्य के ग्रंथ को पढ़ते हैं, वह पल देखने के लिए जब भारतीय गणित अपनी पैरों पर खड़ी होती है — व्यवहार के लिए गढ़ी, पर अपनी परंपरा से सजग।

panels.shot: final contemplative close-up of Mahaviracharya against abstract backdrop of numbers and shapes
panels.action: Mahaviracharya’s calm face is set against a faint, stylized backdrop of numerals, fractions, geometric figures and shadow lines, all flowing like a river around him.

dialogue.text: Mahaviracharya’s legacy lies not in inventing all rules, but in arranging them so that knowledge could be counted, carried and grown by generations to come.

i18n.hi: महावीराचार्य की विरासत सारी नियमों की रचना में नहीं, बल्कि उन्हें ऐसे सहेजने में है कि ज्ञान को पीढ़ियाँ गिन सकें, ढो सकें और आगे बढ़ा सकें।

subtitle_i18n.en: In the court of Amoghavarsha, a Jain scholar gathers scattered rules into a clear river of number and measure.
subtitle_i18n.hi: अमोघवर्ष की सभा में, एक जैन विद्वान बिखरे नियमों को संख्या-नाप की साफ धारा में बदलता है।
